fields.FIR_Description: As per the complaint recorded on 2025-04-19, a caller repeatedly demanded Rs. 25,000 from Senthil Rajan and threatened to visit the premises. The time of the incident was given as 22:45 on 2025-04-19. Karthik Pandian (9000000137) reported the matter for Senthil Rajan, whose contact number is given as 9000000019. Madhan Palanisamy (9000000295) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complaint mentions Balaji Karuppasamy, who was reportedly contacted on 9000000407, in connection with the events. The complainant mentioned mobile phone records.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Caller allegedly demanded money with threats of consequences.
fields.Keywords: extortion, money demand, mobile number, witness, phone records, residential colony, suspect, night
